name: Gopher Board
description: Example of the admin and editor UI API: an admin page with a form, a Dashboard widget, a meta box with declarative fields, a dynamic block for Pursae Editor and a Pursae Web Builder widget.
author: Pursae Contributors

setup.title: Open the Gopher Board
setup.body: The board lives under Tools. Add a first note with the form at the top of the page.

setup.title: Add the Dashboard widget
setup.body: The Gopher Board widget shows the latest notes on the Dashboard. Use Screen Options to show or hide it.

setup.title: Use the block and the meta box
setup.body: Edit a post: the Gopher meta box sits under the editor and the Gopher Board block is in the block inserter.
